player_prompt.intro:
Tllaḥt tɛṣṣaṣt tamukrist n Sokoban. Tkul d amukris, tllaḥt a ten-tekkes iɣallen akkʷ s tɣallen n tɣzi.
        Mllakʷḍ dɣa iɣal, tzemreḍ a ten-tekkes s tɣzi nni.
        Ur tzemreḍ a ten-tekkes ɣef uɣal, ur tzemreḍ a ten-ɣelles.
        Ɣef uɣal, tɣallen ttwakkan s: 
        - Amukris (tkul) ittwakka s 'P' 
        - Iɣallen n uɣal ttwaɣalen s '#' 
        - Iɣallen n tɣzi ttwaɣalen s 'X' 
        - Tɣallen n tɣzi ttwakkan s 'O'
        - Iɣallen n tɣzi ɣef tɣzi ttwakkan s '√'
        Tzemreḍ a tseqdeḍ [w] i ufella, [a] i tamaẓẓayt, [s] i wadda, [d] i tamaẓẓi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Aɣbalu n uṭṭun ur igi ara aṭas n tɛebbuṛt. Sken [up], [down], [left], [right] neɣ [w], [a], [s], [d].
